responsibilities: Drive the implementation of a world-class metric layer for the company: modelling conventions, project structure, testing, CI, and documentation.
Design and maintain the certified KPI layer for product (activation, adoption, retention, usage), finance (billing, ARR, revenue), and company-wide topics, built to withstand audit scrutiny.
